original_question: Determine whether the range of the complex Monge-Ampere operator acting on locally bounded plurisubharmonic functions is characterized by a uniform integrability condition.
target_in_paper: Section 2.3, Question 13 (Bedford): "Is the range of the complex Monge-Amp`ere operator acting on PSH ∩ L^\infty_{loc} characterized by a uniform integrability condition ?"
correct_elements: Your draft correctly identifies the precise local problem singled out in the paper: the range of the complex Monge-Ampère operator on locally bounded plurisubharmonic functions, and the fact that the sought characterization is by a uniform integrability condition.
missing_details: The paper’s question is local: it concerns plurisubharmonic functions on a domain Ω ⊂ ℂ^n, not the compact Kähler setting discussed elsewhere in Section 2.
The operator should be made explicit as the Bedford–Taylor complex Monge-Ampère operator φ ↦ (dd^cφ)^n acting on PSH(Ω) ∩ L^∞_{loc}(Ω).
What is being characterized is the range of this operator as a class of positive Radon/Borel measures μ on Ω satisfying μ = (dd^cφ)^n for some φ ∈ PSH(Ω) ∩ L^∞_{loc}(Ω).

The paper does not specify a candidate integrability criterion in higher dimension; the nearby context only gives the one-dimensional model: μ = Δφ with φ locally bounded subharmonic iff SH(Ω) ⊂ L^1_{loc}(μ).
Your draft does not indicate that the question is intended as a necessary-and-sufficient measure-theoretic characterization, not merely a sufficient condition.

Question 13 itself does not impose boundary conditions, hyperconvexity, or continuity of φ; those belong to the subsequent bounded/continuous Dirichlet subsolution questions (Questions 14 and 15), so they should not be folded into the main formulation.
refined_question: Let Ω ⊂ ℂ^n be a domain, and let μ be a positive Radon measure on Ω. Characterize the measures μ that lie in the range of the Bedford–Taylor complex Monge-Ampère operator on locally bounded plurisubharmonic functions; that is, determine whether there exists a necessary and sufficient uniform integrability condition on μ, analogous in complex dimension 1 to SH(Ω) ⊂ L^1_{loc}(μ), such that μ = (dd^cφ)^n for some φ ∈ PSH(Ω) ∩ L^∞_{loc}(Ω) if and only if μ satisfies that condition.
justification: The draft is essentially a paraphrase of Bedford’s Question 13 in Section 2.3. The nearby discussion fixes the intended scope: the local Bedford–Taylor operator on PSH ∩ L^∞_{loc}, not the finite-energy or compact-manifold range problems from Sections 2.1–2.2. The authors immediately explain the one-dimensional prototype criterion SH(Ω) ⊂ L^1_{loc}(μ), which is the only concrete form of the desired “uniform integrability condition” supplied in the paper, and then distinguish this question from the separate subsolution formulations in bounded hyperconvex domains and on compact Kähler manifolds. So the refined version should remain a local measure-characterization problem for μ = (dd^cφ)^n with φ locally bounded plurisubharmonic.

citations.label: Question 13 context: the one-dimensional criterion SH(Ω) ⊂ L^1_{loc}(μ)
